messages.content: Peggy has 6 dolls.  Her grandmother gives Peggy her own collection of 30 dolls.  Over the year, Peggy receives half that amount of dolls between her birthday and Christmas.  How many dolls does Peggy now have?

Peggy starts with 6 dolls. Her grandmother gives her 30 dolls. So, initially, Peggy has:
\[ 6 + 30 = 36 \text{ dolls} \]

Next, Peggy receives half of 30 dolls between her birthday and Christmas. Half of 30 is:
\[ \frac{30}{2} = 15 \text{ dolls} \]

Adding these 15 dolls to her current total:
\[ 36 + 15 = 51 \text{ dolls} \]

So, Peggy now has 51 dolls. 

FINAL: 51
